title: Park condition scores at the public-space grant sites
question: Did the Rec and Park sites in the public-space grant score differently from other parks while the grant ran, and after it ended?
finding: Nothing unusual. The 12 scored sites rose 4.3 points from FY2018 to FY2023 against 1.3 for other parks (a random set of 12 parks does as well or better 9% of the time), and moved -1.5 points from FY2023 to FY2025 against +1.1 (10% by chance).
how: Scores (0 to 1) from the Controller's evaluation file; the 12 Rec and Park sites in the site layer that carry a score were matched by name (Noe Valley Town Square and La Playa carry none; the Jerry Garcia Amphitheater is inside John McLaren Park and was left out). Chance: 5,000 random sets of 12 parks with both years. No FY2021 scores were published.
limits: The scores measure maintenance by Rec and Park staff; the grant paid for activation and stewardship, so the two need not move together. Twelve sites is a small group. Scores are not spending: no file on disk gives money spent per park.

columns.t: Share of random draws as extreme
